permit.applies: the employer, through the MLVT's online portal
permit.first: the MLVT's foreign employee quota approval for the employer, and the worker's E-class visa

sources.title: Tilleke & Gibbins, Cambodia Sets New Work Permit Rules for Foreign Employees (12 January 2024) — quoting MLVT Notification No. 110/23 of 28 December 2023; Prakas 195 of 20 August 2014; the instruments' own text is on the MLVT's prakas list (https://www.mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/ប្រកាស.html, saved KH-mlvt-prakas.html) but no file for them was found there by title (2026-11-01)
sources.said: A foreign employee whose name is stated in an enterprise’s patent tax certificate must hold a foreign work permit and an employment card. Self-employed individuals must hold a foreign work permit and an employment card. Applications for work permits and employment cards can be submitted through the MLVT’s online portal
sources.quotes: https://www.mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/ប្រកាស.html

sources.title: ASEAN Briefing (Dezan Shira & Associates), A Guide to Employment Permits for Foreign Workers in Cambodia — quoting Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training, Prakas 195 of 2014 on work permits and employment cards; the instruments' own text is on the MLVT's prakas list (https://www.mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/ប្រកាស.html, saved KH-mlvt-prakas.html) but no file for them was found there by title (2026-11-01)
sources.said: In addition to an E-visa, a foreign worker must also obtain a work permit and employment card. This is the responsibility of the employer who will apply through the MVLT. … A work permit is issued for one year, and regardless of when it was issued during the year, it is valid up to December 31 of the year of issuance. The application for its renewal must be made at the MLVT between January 1 and March 30, each year. … Foreign employee quota approval; … The MLVT imposes a maximum 10 percent quota of an employer’s total workforce for the use of foreign employees.
sources.quotes: https://www.mlvt.gov.kh/index.php/ឯកសារផ្លូវការ/ប្រកាស.html

note: Cambodia: the employer applies to the Ministry of Labour and Vocational Training through its online system for the foreign employee's work permit and employment card, within the firm's foreign employee quota (at most 10% of its workforce), the worker holding an E-class visa. A permit is issued for one year and expires on 31 December of the year of issue whatever the date granted, renewed between 1 January and 30 March. Read only in secondary sources (Tilleke & Gibbins on Notification 110/23 of 28 December 2023; ASEAN Briefing on Prakas 195 of 2014), as no MLVT page was reached. No performers' route, union step, minimum pay or exempt days found.
